experiment: Exp8D multi-block residual caching with periodic refresh
prompt_for_default_task: What is 15 multiplied by 12? Explain briefly.
benchmark_method: Warmup; for every task, seed, repeat and config, synchronized B-C-B (baseline-cache-baseline) generation calls. Latency includes token-history hook and cache logic, excludes offline CSV processing. Paired baseline is average(before, after); report median paired saving.
cache_method: For each selected layer, refresh runs original decoder block and stores FP32 residual output-input. Reuse bypasses block.forward() and computes current_input + cached_residual. Earlier cached layers may affect the inputs to later refreshed layers. Built-in HF KV cache disabled for both modes.
caveats: Actual single-GPU whole-generation timings, not edge-cloud measured. Approximate internal activations despite exact token trajectory in some runs. Exact sequence agreement over tested prompts/seeds is not a general quality guarantee. CUDA overhead, synchronization, sampling, and system load affect latency.
